title: Concurrent Programming & C++ Threading Quiz
description: A quiz covering basic units of execution, processes vs threads, thread management, mutexes, and race conditions.

quiz.question: In concurrent programming, the two basic units of program execution are __________.
__________ is considered as a program or application that has self-contained memory and resources.
__________ are entities within a process that share memory and resources.
Which of the following statements is false?
options: A thread is the flow of execution, from beginning to end, of a task.
A program may consist of many tasks that can run concurrently.
Threads enable programs to execute across several processor cores.
Threading can make program more responsive, more interactive, and enhance performance.

quiz.question: Targets in thread th(target) are callable objects that are typically __________.
To pass arguments to threads by reference, use __________.
Use __________ to get the identifier of the current thread.
Use __________ to suspend execution of the current thread for a given number of seconds.
Once a thread object is created, it begins execution __________.
options: by calling the thread's start() function.
by calling the thread's boot() function.
by calling the thread's resume() function.

quiz.question: Call a thread’s __________ method to block the calling thread until the thread is terminated.
Which of the following is about "race condition"?
options: Two or more threads compete for a condition (for example a timer) to complete their tasks earlier.
A shared resource is accessed simultaneously by multiple threads.
The control with which the order of threads being scheduled is determined.
An approach when the Operating System decides which thread to be suspended and which to be executed.

quiz.question: Code is said to be __________ if it does not cause a race condition in the presence of multiple threads.
A mutex lock is in one of two states: __________.
A __________ is used to protect shared data from being simultaneously accessed by multiple threads.
When a thread __________ a lock, it enters the locked state and subsequent attempts will be blocked until the lock is __________.
__________ is a mutex wrapper based on RAII, for owning a mutex only in a scoped block.
__________ means that two or more threads are blocked forever, waiting for each other.
